title: Polynomial representation of circuit evaluation
statement: Let $C$ be an arithmetic circuit with $n$ inputs, let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $x\in R^n$. Evaluating the integer-coefficient multivariate polynomial represented by $C$ at $x$ gives the same value as evaluating the circuit $C$ at $x$.
